### Weather
```{r}
get_venue_tz <- function(venue) {
  if (venue %in% c("Perth Stadium", "Optus Stadium", "Hands Oval")) {
    return("Australia/Perth")
  } else if (venue %in% c("Adelaide Oval", "Norwood Oval", "Barossa Park", "Marrara Oval", "Traegar Park")) {
    return("Australia/Adelaide")
  } else if (venue %in% c("Gabba", "Carrara", "People First Stadium")) {
    return("Australia/Brisbane")
  } else {
    return("Australia/Melbourne") # AEST covers VIC, NSW, TAS, ACT
  }
}

# 1. Load the data
upcoming_round <- fetch_fixture_squiggle(2026, 12)
afl_ovals <- read.csv("AFL Ovals.csv")

# 2. Join the upcoming round with stadium coordinates
matches_with_weather <- upcoming_round %>%
  inner_join(afl_ovals, by = c("venue" = "Stadium"))

weather_results <- list()

cat("Fetching forecasts for the upcoming round...\n")

# 3. Loop through every match
for (i in 1:nrow(matches_with_weather)) {
  
  match <- matches_with_weather[i, ]
  
  # FIX 1: Apply the correct local time zone for the specific stadium
  venue_tz <- get_venue_tz(match$venue)
  match_time_local <- ymd_hms(match$localtime, tz = venue_tz)
  match_time_utc <- with_tz(match_time_local, tzone = "UTC")
  
  # Fetch forecast
  forecast <- get_metno_forecast(
    latitude = match$Latitude, 
    longitude = match$Longitude
  )
  
  # FIX 2: Find the CLOSEST available forecast time instead of demanding an exact match
  match_weather <- forecast$data %>%
    mutate(time_diff = abs(as.numeric(difftime(time, match_time_utc, units = "hours")))) %>%
    arrange(time_diff) %>%
    slice(1) # Grabs the single row with the smallest time difference
  
  # Build the final row
  if(nrow(match_weather) > 0) {
    
    is_raining <- match_weather$precipitation_amount[1] > 0.5
    
    weather_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      Date = as.character(match_time_local),
      Venue = match$venue,
      Is_Raining = is_raining,
      Temp_C = match_weather$air_temperature[1]
    )
    
  } else {
    weather_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      Date = as.character(match_time_local),
      Venue = match$venue,
      Is_Raining = NA,
      Temp_C = NA
    )
  }
}

# Combine and print the clean table
final_weather_table <- bind_rows(weather_results)
print(final_weather_table)
```
